preferredHosts.title: Preferred file hosts
preferredHosts.description: File hosts to list first, in this order. Hosts not listed keep the thread's order. Empty keeps the thread's order for all links.

preferredPlatform.title: Preferred platform
preferredPlatform.description: Show only links for this platform. Use any to show all links. Links with an unknown platform are always shown.

downloadRoot.title: Save downloads into
downloadRoot.description: The launcher's downloads folder, or its games folder.

gameSubfolder.title: Put each game in its own folder
gameSubfolder.description: Make a folder named after the game inside the download folder.

installAfterDownload.title: Unpack the archive after download
installAfterDownload.description: Unpack the downloaded archive into the games folder.

deleteArchiveAfterInstall.title: Delete the archive after install
deleteArchiveAfterInstall.description: Remove the archive once it has been unpacked. Only applies when unpacking is on.

updateCheckIntervalHours.title: Update check interval (hours)
updateCheckIntervalHours.description: The least time between update checks of the same game. 0 checks every time. Inside the interval the plugin does not contact F95 Zone and reports no update. The timer starts again when the plugin restarts.

requestDelayMs.title: Delay between requests (ms)
requestDelayMs.description: Extra wait between two requests to any site. The launcher already spaces requests to one site by 250 ms. Use a higher value to be gentler with sites.

userAgent.title: Browser identity
userAgent.description: The User-Agent header sent to F95 Zone.
userAgent.default: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/126.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

browserAssistEnabled.title: Browser assist
browserAssistEnabled.description: Open a browser to capture the links behind forum download buttons. When off, those downloads fail with a message.

useExternalChrome.title: Use external Chrome (old route)
useExternalChrome.description: Open the plugin's own Chrome, Edge or Chromium window instead of the launcher's embedded browser. This is the old route and needs Chrome or Edge installed.

browserPath.title: Browser program
browserPath.description: The Chrome, Edge or Chromium program used by the old external browser route. Leave empty to use the usual install locations.

verboseLogging.title: Verbose logging
verboseLogging.description: Write a debug line for each request: host name, status and time. Paths are not logged.

dumpDir.title: Page dump folder
dumpDir.description: Save pages that fail to parse here as .html files. Leave empty to turn this off. Saved pages can contain your account name.
